byte_order: little-endian IEEE754 binary32/binary64 and signed int32

numerical_contract.active_input_policy: finite and bounded; NaN values intentionally mark only padded steps
numerical_contract.comparison: abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference), on every live output and final-state element
numerical_contract.gates: active alpha,beta in [0,1], including exact 0 and near-one values
numerical_contract.inputs_and_state: FP32 represented values; independent oracle uses FP64
numerical_contract.key_policy: active test keys are generated unit length; runner never normalizes them
numerical_contract.output_padding: runner initializes outputs to SENTINEL and requires padded locations to remain unchanged
